records.label: spacr.attribution#10
records.source: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR classifier's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.context: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR machine-learning classification model's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.translation: **Dos formas de cabeza, un contrato.** La cabeza de un clasificador de spaCR emite un logit (binario; clase 1 cuando el logit es positivo) o ``C`` logits. El código que supone una forma es incorrecto para la otra, y lo es en silencio: atribuir el logit sin procesar de una cabeza de un solo logit siempre explica la *clase 1*, de modo que para una imagen que el modelo clasificó como clase 0, el mapa obtenido es el de la clase que rechazó — la negación de lo que se pidió. Todos los métodos de aquí pasan por :class:`ClassScoreModel`, que presenta un único logit ``z`` como la vista de dos columnas ``[-z, +z]``. Así, ambas clases tienen un gradiente real, ``target`` significa lo mismo para ambas formas de cabeza y ningún llamador necesita saber qué cabeza tiene.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#1
records.source: Optical pooled screening images the same well twice: once at low magnification to read the barcodes, once at high magnification to measure the phenotype. Every cell must be matched between the two, and the obvious method -- correlate the images -- does not work. The pixels do not correspond: the scale differs, the stains differ, and often the microscope differs too.

records.translation: El cribado óptico agrupado (optical pooled screening) captura el mismo pocillo dos veces: una a bajo aumento para leer los códigos de barras y otra a alto aumento para medir el fenotipo. Cada célula debe emparejarse entre ambas, y el método obvio -- correlacionar las imágenes -- no funciona. Los píxeles no se corresponden: la escala difiere, las tinciones difieren y, a menudo, también difiere el microscopio.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#2
records.source: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.
records.context: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.
records.translation: Lo que se conserva es la disposición de las células. Si se toman tres células vecinas, la forma del triángulo que forman no cambia con el aumento, la rotación ni la traslación. Por eso las células se trianguan, cada triángulo se reduce a un descriptor que depende solo de su forma y los dos conjuntos se emparejan según esos descriptores. La transformación entre las adquisiciones se deduce de los triángulos emparejados y, con ella, se emparejan las células.

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#3
records.source: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screen; a dropped one costs only statistical power, which more cells can buy back.
records.context: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screening experiment; a dropped one costs only statistical detection sensitivity, which more cells can buy back.
records.translation: El emparejamiento es de vecino más cercano mutuo con un límite de distancia: un par se conserva solo cuando cada célula es la más cercana de la otra, y todo lo dudoso se descarta en lugar de asignarse. Una célula emparejada por error da a un fenotipo real el código de barras equivocado, lo que corrompe en silencio un cribado; una descartada solo cuesta potencia estadística, que se recupera con más células.

records.source: The last row is a failure and is recorded as one. Triangle shape is what carries the signal, and jitter of a few pixels on a cell a few tens of pixels across changes that shape materially -- so the method degrades with centroid noise rather than with cell count. records.translation: La última fila es un fallo y se registra como tal. records.source: Read-only UI housekeeping (``journal=False`` — a history refresh, a model scan) is cancelled and waited for exactly like everything else, but it never appears in the return value. It writes nothing, so there is no half-written artefact to protect, and a caller that treats it as a veto turns "the run-history list is still loading" into "the application cannot be closed". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` answers a non-empty return by refusing to close *and showing a modal*: on a headless run — CI, a test shard — nothing can ever dismiss that modal, and the process spins in its nested event loop with no forward progress. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.

No escriben nada, así que no hay ningún artefacto a medio escribir que proteger, y un llamador que lo trate como un veto convierte "la lista del historial de ejecuciones aún se está cargando" en "la aplicación no se puede cerrar". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` responde a un valor devuelto no vacío negándose a cerrar *y mostrando un modal*: en una ejecución sin pantalla — CI, un fragmento de pruebas — nada puede descartar ese modal, y el proceso gira en su bucle de eventos anidado sin avanzar. Un trabajo de mantenimiento que sobrevivía a la pantalla que lo inició bastaba antes para provocarlo.

Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.translation: La fuente QSS de un widget se resuelve cuando se pule, lo que en una pantalla incluida en una página apilada ocurre de camino a la primera visualización. Medir aquí además de en el cambio de fuente es lo que evita que una fila a la que nunca se envió un cambio de fuente -- porque heredó íntegra su fuente -- se dimensione con las métricas predeterminadas.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#1
records.source: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any run folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.context: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any processing-session folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.translation: El registro de reinicio guarda el módulo actual, sus ajustes, un resumen de las ejecuciones activas y las ubicaciones de las carpetas de ejecución. :func:`save` verifica el registro antes de que termine el proceso actual y :func:`take` lo consume cuando arranca el nuevo proceso, para que el estado obsoleto no se restaure repetidamente.

records.label: spacr.restart_state#2

records.translation: Solo se restaura la configuración de la interfaz. Los cálculos activos no se reanudan tras un reinicio forzado; la salida escrita antes del reinicio permanece en las carpetas de ejecución registradas.
